name: Session Check
description: See at a glance which of your Orca worktrees still have uncommitted files, unpushed commits, stashes or a running agent, and which sessions are safe to close. Status bar count and a notification when an agent leaves open work. Read-only, no network.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Session Check: worktrees with uncommitted files

settings.title: Base branch
settings.description: Branch that counts as "already merged", for example origin/main. Leave empty to detect it from origin/HEAD.

settings.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open panel rescans, 10 to 300.

settings.title: Background refresh (seconds)
settings.description: How often the status bar count is refreshed without the panel, 30 to 600. 0 turns it off (agent and workspace events still update it).

settings.title: Notify when an agent finishes
settings.description: Desktop notification when an agent in a worktree finishes and the worktree still has uncommitted files, new files or unpushed commits. At most one per worktree every 10 minutes.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the panel, the status bar and the notification. Automatic follows Orca's language and falls back to English.
